params.body:
Since #378 a trend goes to gentells.com with every signal, but each one still came as the six-card teaser shaped it: the note cut at 90 characters mid-sentence, the source as its feed title ("All Content from Business Insider", a report's file name) and no day. Under a trend with fifty signals that makes the evidence hard to read and impossible to date.

`trendSignalsForSite` now reads its own rows instead of `getInsightSignalSample`:

- `label`: the note whole, capped at 240 characters only so a pasted article does not ride along
- `source`: `readerSourceName`, which drops syndication wrappers (`All Content from`, `Latest stories from`, `- RSS Feed`) and file-name residue
- `date`: the published day, or the day it was read when the source gave none
- `platform`: so the site can mark a report chunk, which has no address to follow

Order and the inspiration-only filter are unchanged. The site groups by source and shows the day (gentells-site PR to follow); it reads the old shape too, so the order of merging does not matter.

Tests: `trend-signals-projection` 3 of 3; full suite 1339 of 1345, the 6 `report-render` failures need pdftoppm and fail on main too.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
params.title: Trend signals go to the site whole: full note, reader source name, day, platform
